intro: This course covered health and safety law, risk assessment, common hazards, manual handling, COSHH, fire, work equipment and reporting incidents in care.
points: The Health and Safety at Work Act 1974 gives you legal duties too — take reasonable care and co-operate with your employer.
Follow the avoid, assess, reduce approach to manual handling, use TILE and the person's plan, and never drag-lift under the arms.
Report hazards, faults, accidents and near misses promptly — a near miss is a free warning that helps prevent the next incident.
Never use equipment that is damaged or out of test date — take it out of use, label it and report it.
Follow labels and COSHH information, keep substances in their original containers, and never mix cleaning chemicals together.
If you discover a fire, raise the alarm, help people evacuate, call 999 and stay out — lives come before property.
